seo.title: Sciorex - AI Research Platform & Vibe Kanban | LaTeX Editor, PDF Annotations | Free
seo.description: Free AI-powered research platform with LaTeX editor, live PDF preview, PDF annotations, reference library, paper discovery, and vibe kanban for AI coding agents. 100% local, no data collection.

subtitle: Where research meets code.
featuresSubtitle: One workspace for writing, research, coding, and automation — powered by AI, controlled by you.

features.title: Bring Your Own AI
features.desc: Use Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, OpenCode, or local models via Ollama and LM Studio. We're a free wrapper — you bring the AI, we provide the workspace.

features.title: Visual Workflows
features.desc: Design multi-agent pipelines with a drag-and-drop editor. 9 node types, conditional branching, parallel execution, debug mode, and event-driven triggers.

features.title: Vibe Kanban
features.desc: Assign tickets to AI agents running in isolated git worktrees. Review every change in diff views, accept or reject individually. Your AI team, your rules.

features.title: Deep AI Integration
features.desc: Your AI doesn't just chat — it operates the app. Through custom MCP tools, any connected CLI can annotate PDFs, manage references, create tickets, and trigger workflows autonomously.

features.title: Research & Writing
features.desc: LaTeX editor with live PDF preview, PDF annotations, reference library with paper discovery across citation networks, and bibliography generation in 11 styles.

features.title: Private & Free
features.desc: Everything stays on your machine. No telemetry, no cloud, no subscriptions. Encrypted vault for secrets. Every feature unlocked from day one.

researcher.title: Researcher
researcher.subtitle: Ask an AI council of experts. Write LaTeX with live preview. Discover papers through citation networks. Annotate, cite, and manage your entire bibliography

developer.title: Developer
developer.subtitle: AI agents working in parallel on isolated git branches. Visual automation pipelines. Any CLI you want — Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, or local models
